description: US-18 Where the Waiting List Speaks — /kunden loses the free-slot banner and gains a small waiting-list count badge beside the Warteliste link; the banner moves to /kunden/neu, where a registration is actually about to happen. Presentation and e2e only: NO domain, application, port, infrastructure or schema change. A diff touching src/domain, src/application, src/infrastructure or prisma/ means the change was misread. Source: tasks/prd-us-18-waiting-list-signals.md

userStories.title: Waiting-list count badge on the Kunden hub
userStories.description: As a staff member, I want the Kunden-verwalten screen to tell me at a glance how many people are on the waiting list, so I can see the queue without opening it. Source: tasks/prd-us-18-waiting-list-signals.md §US-18.1
acceptanceCriteria: HubActions in src/app/kunden/page.tsx renders a badge beside the existing '/warteliste' link, in the same row as the cards-due badge

The badge reuses the cards-due badge's exact styling in its neutral state — same rounded pill, same neutral grey, same tabular numerals — so the two read as one row of counts, not two competing widgets
The count is the number of applicants still waiting, taken from the listWaiting call the page ALREADY makes (const places): use places.length. Do NOT add a use case, a port method or a count query

The badge is shown at zero too, reading 'niemand wartet' — a badge that vanishes leaves staff unable to tell 'nobody waiting' from 'the number failed to load' (same reasoning as the cards-due badge, US-13.4)
German inflects at one: '1 Wartende:r' for one, '3 Wartende' for more
All strings live in de.customerList.actions.* in src/i18n/de.ts; no German literal in the component
The badge carries data-testid="waiting-list-badge"
The badge sits INSIDE the Link to /warteliste, exactly as the cards-due badge sits inside its link, so clicking it opens the waiting list
Do not touch the free-slot banner in this story — US-003 removes it. Landing the removal before the badge exists would leave /kunden with no waiting-list signal at all
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
Verify in browser using the playwright-cli skill, reading the ACCESSIBILITY SNAPSHOT and not only a screenshot: the badge must read as part of the 'Warteliste' link, not as a stray number

userStories.title: The badge says 'Platz frei' when a customer number is free
userStories.description: As a staff member, I want the waiting-list badge to look different when a customer number is actually free, so the queue that can be served right now stands out from the queue that merely exists. Source: tasks/prd-us-18-waiting-list-signals.md §US-18.2
acceptanceCriteria: When proposeRegistration reports a non-null customerNumber AND at least one applicant is waiting, the badge reads the count followed by 'Platz frei' (e.g. '3 Wartende · Platz frei')
In that state the badge carries a subtle accent — a tinted background and border. NOT red and NOT amber: those are spoken for by blocked status and expiring certificates, and this is not an alarm

The accent is NEVER the only carrier of the state — the word 'Platz frei' always accompanies it. A colour-only marking is forbidden by docs/ui_conversion_guide.md and US-03.4 (one shared machine, variable lighting)
Otherwise the badge is the plain neutral pill from US-001, count only
The word never appears without a free number, and the accent never appears without the word
The badge names NO applicant and NO customer number — those belong to the banner, and the hub is deliberately not where that decision is made

The page already calls proposeRegistration and already catches NoSettingsInForce by returning null. Keep that catch: with no settings the badge still renders its count in the neutral state and the page does NOT become an error screen
The badge carries data-free-slot="true" | "false" alongside its data-testid, so e2e can assert the state rather than a colour
Strings in de.customerList.actions.* in src/i18n/de.ts; none inline
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
Verify in browser using the playwright-cli skill in BOTH states — with a free number and with a full register

userStories.title: The free-slot banner leaves /kunden and lands on /kunden/neu
userStories.description: As a staff member about to register a new household, I want to be told that somebody has been waiting for the very number I am about to hand out, so a walk-in does not quietly jump the queue. Source: tasks/prd-us-18-waiting-list-signals.md §US-18.3
acceptanceCriteria: FreeSlotBanner is removed from src/app/kunden/page.tsx entirely — the import goes, the render goes, and /kunden shows no waiting-list-free-slot element in ANY state
The listWaiting and proposeRegistration calls in /kunden STAY: US-001 and US-002 need both for the badge
src/app/kunden/neu/page.tsx renders FreeSlotBanner above RegistrationScreen, below the heading and intro, so it is read before the first field is typed

The banner appears ONLY when someone is waiting AND proposal.customerNumber is not null. With an empty waiting list there is no banner at all; with a full register there is no number to offer and the form already says so
The head of the queue is listWaiting's FIRST place and nobody else — the same reading /warteliste makes, so the two screens can never name two different applicants. Do not re-sort or re-derive it
/kunden/neu already awaits proposeRegistration; add the listWaiting call CONCURRENTLY (Promise.all), not in sequence
waitingListDeps is imported from src/app/warteliste/deps.ts — the same cross-route import /kunden already makes
showListLink is TRUE here: the waiting list is not on view on this screen, so the banner offers the way to it
FreeSlotBanner itself is NOT modified — it already takes head, customerNumber and showListLink
The banner does not block, disable or pre-empt the registration form. It states a fact; DF decide who is served, not the software
/kunden/neu still renders normally with an empty waiting list, and its existing NoSettingsInForce branch is untouched
/warteliste is untouched: same banner, same conditions, same content
No new German strings are needed
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
Verify in browser using the playwright-cli skill in three states: empty waiting list, waiting list plus a free number, waiting list plus a full register

userStories.title: E2E follows the signals to their new screens
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the Playwright suite to assert where each signal now lives, so the move is a contract and not a coincidence. Source: tasks/prd-us-18-waiting-list-signals.md §US-18.4
acceptanceCriteria: tests/e2e/waiting-list.spec.ts: the assertion in 'archiving a household frees a number and the banner names the longest wait' that reads waiting-list-free-slot-detail on /kunden is MOVED to /kunden/neu, with the same expected text
Same test gains an assertion that /kunden shows NO waiting-list-free-slot element after that archive
tests/e2e/customer-list.spec.ts: the waiting-list-badge states the number of applicants waiting, and reads 'niemand wartet' when the list is empty
The badge's data-free-slot is asserted as "true" when a number is free and "false" when the register is full, using the existing archive fixture — never by reading a colour
Expected German comes from the de dictionary in the spec, never as a literal string
The existing 'jede der drei Aktionen über der Liste führt auf ihre Seite' test still passes
tests/e2e/home.spec.ts is UNCHANGED — the Start dashboard never carried either signal, and its 'waiting-list-free-slot has count 0' assertion stays true
No assertion is deleted, only re-pointed
The full Playwright suite is green
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
